newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher on high-techs and banks.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher on high-techs and banks.

text.p: Tokyo stocks surged in early morning trade on Wednesday, led by technology and bank shares.
A continuing bull run in technology stocks in New York and the yen's decline against the dollar supported exporters in the technology sector, brokers said.
News late on Tuesday that the Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and Swiss Bank Corp (SBC) would form a strategic alliance supported bank shares.
By 0015 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average had gained 227.92 points or 1.14 percent to trade at 20,297.33. Its September futures rose 280 points to 20,350.
